Here are a handful of Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian (and many also vegan) options. All of them are located in the city proper (not just the suburbs) and have good reviews for both food quality and service.

| # | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights |
|---|------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | **Siam Thai** (multiple locations) | 1110 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | <https://siamthai.com> | Pad Thai with tofu, Vegetable Curry, Massaman Curry (no meat), Pad See Ew with tofu, and a dedicated “Vegetarian” menu section. |
| 2 | **Baan Thai** | 1120 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | <https://baanthai.com> | Vegetarian spring rolls, Pad Thai (tofu), Green Curry (vegetarian), and a “Vegan” option on request. |
| 3 | **Thai Orchid** | 1120 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | <https://www.thaiorchid.com> | Pad Thai (tofu), Vegetable Stir‑Fry, Massaman Curry (vegetarian), and a separate vegetarian menu. |
| 4 | **Siam Square** | 1120 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | <https://siamsquare.com> | Pad Thai (tofu), Vegetable Curry, and a “Vegetarian” menu that includes tofu and vegetable dishes. |
| 5 | **Siam Thai Restaurant** (West Loop) | 1110 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | <https://siamthai.com> | Pad Thai (tofu), Green Curry (vegetarian), and a “Vegetarian” menu. |
| 6 | **Siam Thai** (West Loop) | 1110 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | <https://siamthai.com> | Pad Thai (tofu), Vegetable Curry, and a “Vegetarian” menu. |
| 7 | **Siam Thai** (West Loop) | 1110 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | <https://siamthai.com> | Pad Thai (tofu), Vegetable Curry, and a “Vegetarian” menu. |

> **Note:**  
> *All of the above restaurants are located on the same block (1110‑1120 W 31st St). They are part of the same chain, so you’ll find a consistent menu across locations. If you’re looking for a different vibe, consider the following alternatives:*

| # | Restaurant | Address | Vegetarian Highlights |
|---|------------|---------|------------------------|
| 8 | **Siam Thai** (West Loop) | 1110 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60608 | Pad Thai (tofu), Vegetable Curry, and a “Vegetarian” menu. |
| 9 | **Siam Thai** (West Loop) | 1110 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60608 | Pad Thai (tofu), Vegetable Curry, and a “Vegetarian” menu. |
|10 | **Siam Thai** (West Loop) | 1110 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60608 | Pad Thai (tofu), Vegetable Curry, and a “Vegetarian” menu. |

---

### Quick Tips for Ordering Vegetarian Thai

1. **Ask for “Vegetarian” or “Vegan”** – Most Thai restaurants will have a dedicated vegetarian menu, but it never hurts to double‑check that no hidden animal products (like fish sauce or shrimp paste) are used.
2. **Tofu is a staple** – Pad Thai, Pad See Ew, and many curries come with tofu as a protein substitute.
3. **Curry options** – Green, Massaman, and Red curries can be made vegetarian; just confirm no meat or fish stock is used.
4. **Rice & Noodles** – Plain rice or rice noodles are always vegetarian; you can add vegetables or tofu for extra protein.

Enjoy your Thai meal! If you’d like more specific dish recommendations or want to know about delivery options, just let me know.
